K001.expected: New question renders with no hover state, or a short input lock after navigation, so a double-click cannot answer two questions.
K001.observed: After choosing 5 years insured, the '5 or more' claims option rendered under the cursor already highlighted; same pattern put 'Business Only' under the cursor after 'No' finance, and on gender, licence and currently-insured steps.
K001.title: Next question's option renders under the cursor and looks pre-selected (mis-click risk on risk answers)

K002.expected: Input mask preserves keystroke order at any speed; DOB auto-advances or accepts DDMMYYYY.
K002.observed: Typing '1991' in YYYY at normal automated speed produced '1919'; typing slowly worked. Day field also silently dropped extra digits instead of advancing.

rechecks.note: Fast typing 1995 in YYYY stored correctly on mobile. Digit-dropping on one-go entry reproduced (see new finding).

K002.title: Year of birth scrambled when typed quickly (1991 saved as 1919)

K003.expected: Separate, optional consent for marketing and calls.
K003.observed: One required tick-box accepts the Privacy Collection Notice and FSG AND agrees to marketing email/SMS AND invites partner calls when a number is given.

rechecks.note: Bundled consent checkbox unchanged on mobile.

K003.title: Single checkbox bundles privacy/FSG acceptance with marketing email/SMS and partner call consent

K004.expected: Sub-second step transitions; journey initialised once.
K004.observed: Each step transition shows a blank page for ~4-5s; network shows POST api/car-journey/journey/initial plus several server_time calls per step. 1100+ console messages over the session.

rechecks.note: ~4-6s blank or faded screen per step on mobile; 7,296 console messages over the session.

K004.title: Every journey step shows 4-5s blank grey screen; journey/initial re-posted on every step

K005.expected: Explain how to tell them apart or merge identical variants.
K005.observed: Both YP S variants show identical engine/transmission/power/drive/kerb mass; only release month differs.

rechecks.note: Badge 'unsure' list for 2018 Sorento: four UM variants with identical specs; only the badge differs.

K005.title: Two identical variants differ only by 'Release: January' vs 'May' with no guidance

K006.expected: Consistent names, accurate eligibility, help that doesn't obscure options.
K006.observed: Help calls it 'Third party property, fire and theft' vs button 'Third Party Fire and Theft'; says TPFT only for cars under $20,000 but offers it for a 2019 Carnival. Comprehensive wording reads as if own-car damage only covered when at fault. Popover covers the heading and third option.

rechecks.note: TPFT offered and accepted for a 2018 Sorento with no market-value check; help popovers cover options on mobile.

K006.title: Cover help text mislabels TPFT and states <$20k rule that the journey doesn't apply

K007.expected: Enter submits a valid step; Next enables as soon as input is valid.
K007.observed: Pressing Enter after typing kilometres did nothing; DOB Next stayed disabled until focus left the year field.

rechecks.note: DOB Next looks disabled with a valid date; tapping it works (visual only).

K007.title: Enter key doesn't submit text steps; Next only enables on blur

K008.expected: Labelled inputs; page titles match the step.
K008.observed: DD/MM/YYYY inputs have no label or aria-label (placeholders only); document title on car_address was 'Cover Type - Car Quote'.

rechecks.note: Address page title still 'Cover Type - Car Quote'.

K008.title: DOB inputs have no labels; address page title says 'Cover Type'

K009.expected: One option or a clear distinction.
K009.observed: Both options shown with no explanation of difference.

rechecks.note: Car Park and Parking Lot both offered.

K009.title: 'Car Park' and 'Parking Lot' offered as separate parking options

K010.observed: Follow-up allows 'None' full years despite prior Yes.

rechecks.note: Likely a false positive: 'None' full years is valid after Yes (insured under 12 months). After No, the 5-year option is correctly removed.

K010.title: 'None' years offered after answering Yes to comprehensive cover in last 12 months

K011.observed: 'KM's travelled per year', '290 KM's per week', 'their drivers licence'.
K011.title: Copy: "KM's" and "drivers licence"

K012.observed: Email field has a green 'valid' border while empty.
K012.title: Empty email field shown green/valid before input

K013.expected: Synthetic sessions tagged and excluded downstream before scheduled prod runs.
K013.observed: Network shows journey id created and POST .../journey/{id}/marketings during the anonymous journey.
K013.title: Production journey record + marketing call created before any contact details

K014.expected: No default when a postcode has several suburbs; require an explicit choice (auto-select only a single-suburb postcode).
K014.observed: Manual address entry, postcode 4068: the Suburb dropdown auto-selected 'Chelmer' (first of Chelmer / Indooroopilly / Taringa), showed it green as valid and enabled Next. The field sits below the fold on mobile.
K014.suggested_fix: Default the suburb select to an empty 'Select suburb' option and validate it as required when there are multiple suburbs.
K014.title: Manual address: suburb silently pre-selected (first alphabetical) after postcode

K015.expected: Auto-advance between DD/MM/YYYY, or accept a full date pasted or typed into the first box.
K015.observed: Typing 01011980 into DD kept '01' and left MM and YYYY empty; no auto-advance, no message. Same on the regular-driver DOB in the 6 Nov run.
K015.suggested_fix: Auto-advance focus when a segment is full and distribute pasted/typed overflow across the fields.
K015.title: Typing a whole date of birth in one go keeps only the day; the rest is silently lost

K016.expected: Help that doesn't hide the answers; a line on accessories vs modifications.
K016.observed: On a 375px phone the '?' popover covers the question and both answers. It defines modifications but not whether an accessory already declared (tow bar) counts.
K016.suggested_fix: Render help inline below the question on small screens; add 'Accessories you declared on the previous step are not modifications'.
K016.title: Modifications help covers the whole question on mobile and doesn't say whether accessories count

K017.observed: Thumb taps on 'click here' (badge unsure) and 'Enter it manually' missed and did nothing; both worked only with an exact tap. axe target-size also fails on the series list.
K017.suggested_fix: Make these links buttons or add padding so the tap area is at least 44px tall.
K017.title: Small inline text links need a precise tap on mobile ('click here', 'Enter it manually')

K018.expected: Confirm with product whether insurers on the panel need this; if so, ask it here rather than at the insurer.
K018.observed: Choosing Foreign Licence goes straight to 'age licence received'; no country, conversion or years-in-Australia question.
K018.title: Foreign licence branch asks nothing about country or time driving in Australia

K019.expected: A short note on what happens next, or a follow-up if insurers need detail.
K019.observed: After Yes the journey moves straight on; no question about extent and no note that some insurers may exclude or decline.
K019.title: 'Yes' to unrepaired hail damage has no follow-up or explanation of impact

K020.expected: Ensure an element's role supports its ARIA attributes
K020.observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'aria-allowed-attr' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance. e.g. #tab-0-tab:
K020.suggested_fix: aria-selected=" true " is not allowed (stray spaces) See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-allowed-attr
K020.title: Accessibility: Invalid ARIA markup, so the tab state may be announced wrongly (car-insurance, WCAG 4.1.2)

K021.expected: Ensure elements with an ARIA role that require parent roles are contained by them
K021.observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'aria-required-parent' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/standard_options. e.g. #factory:
K021.suggested_fix: Required ARIA parent role not present: tablist See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-required-parent
K021.title: Accessibility: Tabs aren't inside a tab list, so they aren't announced as tabs (standard_options, WCAG 1.3.1)

K022.expected: Ensure all ARIA attributes have valid values
K022.observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'aria-valid-attr-value' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance. e.g. #tab-0-tab:
K022.suggested_fix: Invalid ARIA attribute value: aria-selected=" true " See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/aria-valid-attr-value
K022.title: Accessibility: An ARIA value is malformed (e.g. ' true ' with spaces) (car-insurance, WCAG 4.1.2)

K023.expected: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA
K023.observed: 30 element(s) fail axe rule 'color-contrast' (, axe impact serious) on 15 step(s): /car-insurance, /car-insurance/journey/start, /car-insurance/journey/standard_options, /car-insurance/journey/car_address, /car-insurance/journey/car_make, /car-insurance/journey/car_year, /car-insurance/journey/car_model, /car-insurance/journey/non_standard_accessories …. e.g. .text-greyscale-300 > p:
K023.title: Accessibility: Text too faint to read comfortably (15 steps, WCAG 1.4.3)

K024.expected: Ensure every form element has a label
K024.observed: 1 element(s) fail axe rule 'label' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_address. e.g. #coverDetail\.overnightParking\.address\.buildingName:
K024.suggested_fix: Building Name input has no programmatic label See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/label
K024.title: Accessibility: A form field has no name, so it's announced as just 'edit text' (car_address, WCAG 1.3.1 / 4.1.2)

K025.expected: Ensure links are distinguished from surrounding text without relying on color
K025.observed: 1 element(s) fail axe rule 'link-in-text-block' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_address. e.g. #overnightParkingAddressToggle:
K025.suggested_fix: Link contrast 1.3:1 with surrounding text and no underline See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/link-in-text-block
K025.title: Accessibility: A link looks like plain text (colour is the only difference) (car_address, WCAG 1.4.1)

K026.expected: Ensure interactive controls are not nested
K026.observed: 1 element(s) fail axe rule 'nested-interactive' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/start. e.g. .registration_number__none__tEhej:
K026.title: Accessibility: A control is nested inside another, so focus and announcements break (start, WCAG 4.1.2)

K027.expected: Ensure elements that have scrollable content are accessible by keyboard
K027.observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'scrollable-region-focusable' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance. e.g. #david-koch-car-insurance-transcript:
K027.suggested_fix: Element should be focusable or contain focusable content See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/scrollable-region-focusable
K027.title: Accessibility: A scrolling box can't be reached or scrolled with the keyboard (car-insurance, WCAG 2.1.1)

K028.expected: Ensure select element has an accessible name
K028.observed: 2 element(s) fail axe rule 'select-name' (, axe impact critical) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_address. e.g. #coverDetail\.overnightParking\.address\.unitType:
K028.suggested_fix: Unit type and Suburb selects have no accessible name See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/select-name
K028.title: Accessibility: A dropdown has no name; users don't know what they're choosing (car_address, WCAG 4.1.2)

K029.expected: Ensure touch targets have sufficient size and space
K029.observed: 9 element(s) fail axe rule 'target-size' (, axe impact serious) on 1 step(s): /car-insurance/journey/car_series. e.g. #internal-link-KIA\ 18AQ:
K029.suggested_fix: Target partially obscured (345px by 10px); should be at least 24px by 24px See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.10/target-size
K029.title: Accessibility: Tap targets are too small to hit reliably (car_series, WCAG 2.5.8)
